timelines.title: Grand Finale: Gaurav Khanna Wins Bigg Boss 19!
timelines.message: In the Grand Finale on Day 105/107, host Salman Khan welcomed star guests. Tanya Mittal finished 5th, Amaal Mallik 4th, and Pranit More as 2nd Runner-up (3rd). Farhana Bhatt finished as 1st Runner-up. Gaurav Khanna lifted the trophy and won the ₹50 Lakh prize money!

timelines.title: Malti Chahar Evicted (6th Place)
timelines.message: In a mid-week finale eviction on Day 102, wildcard entry Malti Chahar was eliminated, securing 6th place and locking in the Top 5 Finalists.

timelines.title: Ashnoor Kaur Ejected; Shehbaz Badesha Evicted
timelines.message: Ashnoor Kaur was ejected on Day 98 for violating house rules in a physical altercation. On Weekend Ka Vaar, Shehbaz Badesha was evicted. Salman Khan announced that all remaining housemates advanced to Finale Week.

timelines.title: Farhana Bhatt Becomes First Finalist
timelines.message: Farhana Bhatt defeated fellow contenders Gaurav, Pranit, and Tanya in the Ticket to Finale task, becoming the first official finalist of Bigg Boss 19.

timelines.title: Ticket to Finale Task Commences
timelines.message: With Shehbaz's captaincy ended, Bigg Boss unveiled the Ticket to Finale trophy in the Assembly Room for a high-stakes multi-part competition.

timelines.title: Kunickaa Sadanand Evicted
timelines.message: After 13 weeks in the house and serving as the first captain, Kunickaa Sadanand was evicted during Weekend Ka Vaar on Day 91.

timelines.title: Family Week Begins
timelines.message: Family Week commenced with the Freeze and Release game. Family members including Kunickaa's son Ayaan, Ashnoor's father Gurmeet, Amaal's brother Armaan Mallik, and Malti's brother Deepak Chahar entered to visit housemates.

timelines.title: Danube Luxury Cruise Surprise
timelines.message: Danube Properties announced a royal surprise for housemates — a luxury cruise trip. Shehbaz Badesha retained his captaincy after App Room evaluations.

timelines.title: Mridul Tiwari Evicted
timelines.message: Mridul Tiwari was evicted on Day 80 after receiving the fewest votes following the Assembly democracy nomination task.

timelines.title: Democracy Assembly Nominations
timelines.message: Housemates engaged in political parliamentary debates in the Assembly Room. The nomination process put Mridul Tiwari and others in danger.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Neelam Giri & Abhishek Bajaj
timelines.message: Weekend Ka Vaar saw another double eviction. Neelam Giri and Abhishek Bajaj were eliminated after receiving the lowest public votes on Day 77.

timelines.title: Pranit More Re-enters House
timelines.message: After recovering from his medical treatment, Pranit More re-entered the house through the storeroom on Day 75 to rejoin the competition.

timelines.title: Shehbaz Badesha Wins Captaincy
timelines.message: Shehbaz Badesha won a musical chairs-style captaincy task on a guitar-shaped dance floor in the garden, becoming the ninth house captain.

timelines.title: Election-Themed Nominations
timelines.message: An election-themed nomination took place in the confession room. Abhishek, Ashnoor, Gaurav, Farhana, and Neelam were nominated for eviction.

timelines.title: Pranit More Exits for Medical Treatment
timelines.message: Pranit More suffered health issues and was temporarily taken out of the Bigg Boss house for hospital care and medical treatment on Day 70.

timelines.title: Tanya Mittal Wins Captaincy
timelines.message: A genius scientist lab captaincy task ended in a tie. Housemates voted in the Assembly Room to elect Tanya Mittal as the eighth house captain.

timelines.title: Rule Break Video & Direct Nominations
timelines.message: Bigg Boss played video footage of Abhishek Bajaj and Ashnoor Kaur discussing nomination strategies. As punishment, Abhishek, Ashnoor, and Mridul Tiwari were directly nominated.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Nehal Chudasama & Baseer Ali
timelines.message: In a major Weekend Ka Vaar double eviction on Day 63, ex-captain Nehal Chudasama and Baseer Ali received the lowest votes and were evicted together.

timelines.title: Gaurav Khanna Becomes Captain
timelines.message: Housemates voted using cue cards in the Assembly Room. Gaurav Khanna won the vote and became the seventh house captain of the season.

timelines.title: Chain Reaction Diwali Nominations
timelines.message: Housemates played a luck-based "Chain Reaction" nomination game. Baseer Ali, Nehal Chudasama, Pranit More, and Shehbaz Badesha were nominated.

timelines.title: Live Musical Concert by Altaf Raja
timelines.message: In a historic first for 19 seasons of Bigg Boss, singer Altaf Raja performed a live musical concert inside the house for the housemates.

timelines.title: Diwali Celebration & No Eviction
timelines.message: On the occasion of Diwali, special guests including Danube Properties leadership visited the house. Host Salman Khan declared a festive no-eviction week.

timelines.title: Family Audio Messages Task
timelines.message: With nearly half the season complete, Bigg Boss arranged an emotional task allowing housemates to earn recorded audio messages from their family members.

timelines.title: Panipuri Stall Nominations
timelines.message: Captain Nehal assigned duties in a garden Panipuri stall nomination task. Abhishek Bajaj, Baseer Ali, Mridul Tiwari, and Shehbaz Badesha were nominated for eviction.

timelines.title: Zeishan Quadri Evicted
timelines.message: Zeishan Quadri received the lowest public votes among the nominees and was evicted on Weekend Ka Vaar on Day 49.

timelines.title: Nehal Chudasama Wins Captaincy
timelines.message: Nehal Chudasama defeated contenders Tanya Mittal and Abhishek Bajaj in a mega pathway captaincy task to become the sixth house captain.

timelines.title: Rival Families Nomination Task
timelines.message: Bigg Boss set up a story-based nomination task between two rival family groups. Zeishan Quadri, Tanya Mittal, Shehbaz Badesha, and Neelam Giri were nominated for eviction.

timelines.title: Wildcard Malti Chahar Enters; Dussehra No Eviction
timelines.message: Malti Chahar entered as the second wildcard contestant. Host Salman Khan announced that no eviction would take place due to Dussehra celebrations.

timelines.title: BB Dino Park Task & Week 6 Nominations
timelines.message: The garden was transformed into BB Dino Park. Housemates competed in a multi-day task where a dinosaur consumed food items. Kunickaa, Neelam, and Zeishan were nominated for eviction.

timelines.title: Captain Farhana Ranks Housemates for Ration
timelines.message: Captain Farhana ranked housemates from 1 to 20 on a board, determining their order for the garden ration shopping task. Amaal, Shehbaz, and Tanya landed in lower ranks.

timelines.title: Awez Darbar Evicted; Nehal Returns
timelines.message: Awez Darbar got the fewest votes and was evicted on Day 35. Meanwhile, Nehal Chudasama returned from the secret room to rejoin the main house.

timelines.title: Farhana Bhatt Wins Captaincy
timelines.message: Guided by secret decisions from Nehal in the secret room, Farhana Bhatt defeated Ashnoor Kaur and Gaurav Khanna in a drone and assembly task to become the fifth house captain.

timelines.title: Team Nomination Task
timelines.message: Two teams competed in an Assembly Room nomination battle. The losing team members — Awez Darbar, Farhana Bhatt, Gaurav Khanna, Mridul Tiwari, and Pranit More — were nominated for eviction.

timelines.title: Nehal Evicted to Secret Room
timelines.message: Host Salman Khan announced Nehal Chudasama's eviction on Weekend Ka Vaar. However, instead of leaving the show, Nehal was secretly sent to the Secret Room to observe housemates.

timelines.title: Abhishek Bajaj Wins Captaincy
timelines.message: After Amaal's captaincy performance was evaluated by housemates, Abhishek Bajaj won a multi-round garden captaincy task to become the fourth house captain.

timelines.title: Rapid Nominations in Assembly Room
timelines.message: Bigg Boss called housemates to the Assembly Room for rapid-fire nominations. Awez Darbar, Nehal Chudasama, Abhishek Bajaj, and Pranit More were nominated for eviction.

timelines.title: Double Eviction: Natalia Janoszek & Nagma Mirajkar
timelines.message: During Weekend Ka Vaar, host Salman Khan announced a double eviction. Natalia Janoszek and Nagma Mirajkar received the lowest public votes and were evicted on Day 21.

timelines.title: Amaal Mallik Becomes Third House Captain
timelines.message: Following the BB Coaching Centre and BB Sports Day tasks, Baseer's captaincy ended. Amaal Mallik defeated Gaurav Khanna in the Scrabble task and final captaincy challenge to become the third house captain.

timelines.title: Week 3 App Room Nominations
timelines.message: Captain Baseer Ali used his power in the App Room to save Ashnoor Kaur from nominations. Housemates nominated Zeishan Quadri, Natalia Janoszek, Nagma Mirajkar, and Nehal Chudasama for eviction.

timelines.title: Shehbaz Enters as Wildcard; App Room Saves Kunickaa
timelines.message: Shehbaz Badesha entered as the first wildcard contestant, joined on stage by sister Shehnaaz Gill. In the App Room, Kunickaa chose the Suraksha Kawach Block Eviction pass, saving herself from eviction and resulting in no eviction for Week 2.

timelines.title: Baseer Ali Wins Captaincy
timelines.message: In a garden captaincy task between contenders Baseer Ali and Awez Darbar, sanchalaks Kunickaa and Tanya declared Baseer Ali the winner, making him the second captain of the season.

timelines.title: Truth & Dare Debate & Dream Machine Task
timelines.message: Bigg Boss held an Assembly Room debate on whether Zeishan ignites conflicts like kerosene. The verdict favored Zeishan, removing Pranit More from the captaincy race. Housemates later competed in the Dream Machine captaincy contendership task.

timelines.title: Kunickaa Dismissed & Room of Fate Nominations
timelines.message: Housemates voted to dismiss Kunickaa Sadanand from captaincy due to leadership failure. In the Room of Fate nomination task, Awez, Mridul, Kunickaa, Tanya, Abhishek, and Amaal were nominated for eviction.

timelines.title: First Weekend Ka Vaar: No Eviction
timelines.message: Host Salman Khan reviewed the first week's drama, secret room revelations, and house dynamics. No contestant was evicted from the nominated pool in the opening week.

timelines.title: App Room Unveiled & Farhana Returns
timelines.message: Bigg Boss opened the App Room. Farhana in the secret room chose Gaurav Khanna to access it. Gaurav picked "Re-entry: Farhana Returns" over "Half Ration", bringing Farhana back into the main house after revealing her secret observations.

timelines.title: Kunickaa Becomes First House Captain
timelines.message: In a stage-and-tile captaincy task sanchalaked by Tanya Mittal, Kunickaa Sadanand appointed Baseer Ali as her representative. Tanya declared Kunickaa the winner, making her the first house captain of Season 19.

timelines.title: Merry-Go-Round Captaincy Contendership Task
timelines.message: Housemates competed in the Merry-Go-Round task in the garden area. Baseer Ali served as sanchalak after being removed from contention by Farhana from the secret room. Ashnoor Kaur, Kunickaa Sadanand, and Abhishek Bajaj emerged as captaincy contenders.

timelines.title: Week 1 Assembly Room Nominations
timelines.message: Housemates participated in the first formal nomination process in the Assembly Room. Seven housemates — Abhishek Bajaj, Gaurav Khanna, Natalia Janoszek, Neelam Giri, Pranit More, Tanya Mittal, and Zeishan Quadri — were nominated for eviction.

timelines.title: Farhana Sent to Secret Room
timelines.message: The Assembly Room was inaugurated. Housemates voted to evict Farhana Bhatt on Day 1. However, in a major twist, Farhana was secretly relocated to a secret room to monitor all housemates.

timelines.title: Grand Premiere: Bigg Boss 19 Launch
timelines.message: Host Salman Khan launched Bigg Boss Season 19 with the tagline "Iss Baar Chalegi Gharwalon Ki Sarkaar". 16 original housemates (Ashnoor Kaur, Zeishan Quadri, Tanya Mittal, Awez Darbar, Nagma Mirajkar, Nehal Chudasama, Abhishek Bajaj, Baseer Ali, Gaurav Khanna, Natalia Janoszek, Pranit More, Farhana Bhatt, Neelam Giri, Kunickaa Sadanand, Mridul Tiwari, Amaal Mallik) entered the house. Shehbaz Badesha was rejected in the Fans Ka Faisla vote. Mridul was voted to sleep outside the bedroom on Day 0.
